journey.name: paykit swap route
journey.description:
Proves that paying a Paykit contact whose only endpoint is on-chain, from a wallet that holds only a spending balance, routes through a Pubky Swaps provider found among the user's own contacts, without the user picking a swap, and that the contact receives the exact amount on chain.
Preconditions: a dev debug build with E2E=true, E2E_BACKEND=local, E2E_HOMESERVER_PUBKY set to the local marketplace homeserver and PUBKY_SWAPS_ROUTES=true; bitkit-docker's default stack with the marketplace, payment-requests and lnurl-pay profiles; the provider running against bitkit-docker's LND and funded; adb reverse for 6286, 6287, 6288, 15411, 15412, 60001, 23735, 23000 and 23010. The wallet has a spending balance from an LNURL channel with bitkit-docker's LND and an empty savings balance, a Pubky profile on the local homeserver, and both the provider's and the fixture-issuer's pubkys saved as contacts. The contact is bitkit-docker's fixture-issuer, which publishes only a btc-regtest-p2wpkh endpoint.

actions.action: Verify the savings balance (tag "ActivitySavings") shows 0 and the spending balance (tag "ActivitySpending") is above 25 000
Verify the contact list shows both the fixture-issuer and the provider, and tap the fixture-issuer (tag "SendContact_" followed by its pubky)
Verify the amount screen (tag "send_amount_screen") offers SPENDING as the source
Verify the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirm") is visible, then tap Show Details (tag "SendConfirmToggleDetails")
Verify FROM is SPENDING, TO is the contact, and ROUTE (tag "ReviewSwapRoute") reads "Pubky Swaps" followed by the provider's shortened pubky
Once the provider logs "HTLC funded; awaiting client claim", mine one block on bitkit-docker's bitcoind
Verify the Bitcoin Sent screen (tag "SendSuccess") is visible
Verify the provider logs "client claimed; hold invoice settled", and bitcoind shows the claim transaction paying exactly 0.0002 BTC to the fixture-issuer's address
